summary: Penalty per unit of deadhead (empty-leg) duration beyond max_deadhead_duration.
businessRules: Soft: discourages long empty first/last legs; pairs with max_deadhead_duration.

deadhead_duration_penalty defines: Specify a penalty to be applied for each unit of deadhead duration exceeding the specified max_deadhead_duration for the vehicle. Default value is 0. Please note that this is ineffective when a max…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.max_deadhead_duration. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
This is a soft constraint. Violations are penalized but don't make solutions infeasible.
Zero means no penalty/cost; larger values increase incentive to avoid violation.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: high penalty pushes vehicles to start/end nearer demand.
